reportTemplate.summary: Signed in successfully. The app is "Repair Desk" — an internal workshop tool for managing repair tickets. The main page shows a **"Repair tickets"** dashboard listing repair jobs in a table with columns: Ref, Title, Customer, Status, Parts, and Created. Navigation consists of a single "Tickets" section in the main nav. The page includes a "New ticket" button, a filter region (Status combobox with Draft/Ready/Closed options, Search box, Show archived checkbox), and pagination (13 tickets across 2 pages). Each ticket is linked to a customer (e.g. Marlow Bakery, The Anchor Inn, Pinehurst Grocers, Blue Fox Cafe) and tracks a parts count. The footer describes it as "Repair Desk — internal workshop tooling. Prices include the configured markup."
